unsupported.source: Don't schedule CS right after physics, I need a mental break between them.
unsupported.reason: Friday can't keep a gap between two specific courses. Buffers apply to every event of a kind (all classes or all meetings), not to one course followed by another. Pacing can't separate CS 2110 work from PHYS 2213 work either.

questions: Do you want a break after every class or meeting, not just physics? Friday could add a buffer for that, for example 30 minutes after classes. Or is the break only about physics and CS?
